name: daily-briefings
description: Scheduled personal briefings that render as self-contained HTML on the owner's own machine. /commitment-calendar builds a rolling N-day commitment grid from the calendar plus a dated-commitment sweep of the inbox, with double-booking, duplicate-invite, location-clash and unprepped-deadline flags. /morning-brief renders today's version of the same picture across calendar, email and chat. /briefings-setup writes the owner config and registers the recurring scheduled tasks. Both renders are three-state honest: a source that could not be read is reported as not checked, never as empty.
